#### Two features for ten digits

Describe each image by the two features so far,
its center ink and its left ink.
Classify each image as the digit whose average pair of features,
over all the images of that digit,
is nearest to the image's own pair.
What share of the images does this classifier get right?
What share would guessing the most common digit get right?

:::
